closure_rule: These paths are ready-to-run learning labs, not an active AI backlog. Progress begins when the owner starts learning and records checkpoints in docs/learning-progress.md.

paths.title: Foundations to transformer
paths.lab: Complete the toy calculation or implementation in Modules 1-7 and explain its tensor shapes aloud.
paths.mastery_gate: Trace text from tokens through embeddings, attention, MLP, logits, loss, and one gradient update without skipping a transformation.

paths.title: Training mechanics and stability
paths.lab: Inspect one successful tiny-overfit and one failed ordinary run, then diagnose data, optimization, capacity, and evaluation separately.
paths.mastery_gate: Given a loss curve and held-out result, identify what is proven and choose the smallest discriminating next test.

paths.title: SFT, adapters, preference tuning, and distillation
paths.lab: Reconstruct the SQL and file-ops lineages, including the variable changed, target gain, regression, and decision at each step.
paths.mastery_gate: Design a recipe with data, target, reward or labels, regression slices, resource budget, stop rule, and ship/retry/reject threshold.

paths.title: Evaluation, evidence, and the specialist factory
paths.lab: Audit Needle, Chess, and 2048 and explain how the ruler or safety gate changed the decision before integration or training.
paths.mastery_gate: Reject a superficially good score when its frontier ruler, safety slice, breadth gate, or provenance is invalid.

paths.title: Inference, serving, tools, and long context
paths.lab: Calculate KV memory, compare cold versus reused-prefill latency, and trace one tool request through model output, validation, and execution policy.
paths.mastery_gate: Separate model capability, serving optimization, validation, and agent policy in one end-to-end trace.

paths.title: Architecture and kernel execution
paths.lab: Match one optimized attention or matmul path against the readable reference and identify the real bottleneck with a measured curve.
paths.mastery_gate: Explain the numerical contract, memory traffic, and why a microbenchmark may not improve end-to-end training.

paths.title: Quantization, pruning, and artifact packaging
paths.lab: Audit one int4 or pruned artifact from source weights through file size, load parity, quality, RAM, and runtime measurement.
paths.mastery_gate: Distinguish a smaller file, lower RAM, fewer physical operations, and faster wall-clock execution.

paths.title: Browser, WASM, WebGPU, MLX, and Apple runtime
sequence: Apple Foundation Models and Core ML boundaries
paths.lab: Compare the WebGPU speedup curve, Memory64 limit, Apple action-grounding result, and Parakeet browser receipt as four different capability boundaries.
paths.mastery_gate: Choose the correct Mac or browser runtime from capability, memory, latency, energy, download, and ownership constraints.

paths.title: Interpretability with causal discipline
paths.lab: Take one behavioral failure and write a probe hypothesis, negative control, intervention, and decision-changing prediction.
paths.mastery_gate: Refuse to turn an attractive visualization into a causal model claim without an intervention.
